title: Websites for Contractors
seoTitle: Websites for Contractors and Home Service Businesses
description: Fast, mobile-first websites for painters, handymen, remodelers and other home service businesses, built to turn visitors into calls and quote requests.
body:
If you run a painting, handyman, remodeling, flooring, fencing or landscaping business, your website has one job: turn the homeowner who just found you into a phone call or a quote request. We build websites for exactly that, using the same approach behind this site's calculators: fast pages, clear answers and nothing in the way of the call button. ## What you get - **A site built for phones first,** with your number tappable on every screen and a quote button that is always in reach. - **One page for each service you offer,** written around what customers search for and what they want to know. - **A service area section** that matches your Google Business Profile. - **A short quote form** that sends requests straight to your email, with photo upload if you want it. - **Your real work up front:** before-and-after galleries and reviews. - **Fast loading,** with compressed images and no heavy page builder. - **Technical setup done for you:** HTTPS, page titles, descriptions, a sitemap, Google Search Console and basic structured data. - **Help with your Google Business Profile** so the profile and the site tell the same story. - **Optional tools,** such as a cost calculator for your trade, which can bring in search traffic and give visitors a reason to stay. ## How it works 1. **Tell us about your business.** Your trade, your towns, your services and any site you have now. Email {{email}}. 2. **Get a fixed-price proposal.** You see the pages, the features and the price before anything starts. No hourly surprises. 3. **We build, you review.** You get a preview link to check on your phone. Two rounds of changes are included. 4. **Launch.** We connect your domain, set up Google Search Console and submit the sitemap. 5. **After launch.** Small text and photo updates are easy to arrange, and you own the site and the domain. ## Who this is for Small and owner-run home service businesses in the US, UK, Canada, Australia and Europe that want a professional site without a big agency price or a monthly website-builder fee. ## Before you contact us It helps to have: - Your logo, if you have one - Ten or more photos of real jobs - A list of your services and the towns you cover - A few reviews you are happy to show Not ready yet? The [contractor website checklist](/blog/contractor-website-checklist/) and the [Google Business Profile guide](/blog/google-business-profile-for-contractors/) are good places to start on your own.
